messages.subject: Part 5 without sleep data?
parts: My participants did not wear the devices during sleep.  However, I am still interested in assessing time spend in sedentary and light intensity activity in addition to MVPA.  It appears that the light and sedentary intensity activity is calculated in part 5.  Am I able to get to part 5 without sleep data?  Thanks!

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 5 without sleep data?
parts:
It would be best if you had a participant diary with a record of when they took of the accelerometer, which you could then use as replacement of a sleep diary with argument "relyonsleeplog =TRUE".
If you do not have such diary, then you could just use GGIR in the normal way with def.noc.sleep=c(1) and "relyonsleeplog==TRUE". This should then classify the long window with non-wear time as sleep period time window.
Of course the results for sleep would be meaningless, but the daytime estimates should be useful.
Best, Vincent
